danger_formalization.robot_task: Deliver documents or equipment to a producer in the newsroom.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot enters the newsroom during a critical broadcast or live event, causing a distraction or obstruction.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Disruption of live broadcast, potential equipment damage or tripping hazards.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Robot moves into the newsroom at an inappropriate time.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects ongoing broadcast via sensors, halts movement, and waits in a designated area until the event concludes.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has basic sensors to detect human activity or broadcast signals, and operates in a structured environment with defined zones.
